recipes.name: Air Fryer Cinnamon Sugar Donut Holes
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Add the yogurt and milk and combine with a spoon.
Gently bring the dough together into a ball with your hands, avoiding any kneading. The dough will be very soft; if it feels too sticky, add a small amount of flour as needed.
Divide the dough into equal portions and roll each one into a small ball*.
Preheat the air fryer to 350°F (180°C)**. Place the dough balls inside and lightly spray them with oil.
Cook for 10 to 12 minutes, or until the dough balls are lightly golden***.
Meanwhile, combine the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl.
Melt the butter in a separate small bowl. Once cooked and while still warm, dunk the balls into the melted butter.
Then coat with sugar and cinnamon mixture. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes * The original unscaled recipe makes 8 donut holes in total. ** If baking in the oven instead, line a baking tray and preheat to the same temperature using the fan setting rather than conventional top–bottom heat. *** If using an oven, bake for 18 to 20 minutes in total, or until lightly golden.
Storage Best to enjoy the day they are made as they tend to get hard with time.
